gltfpack.use: GLB LOD generation and simplification (-si ratio), meshopt compression
gltfpack.notes: Default output quantizes vertex attributes (KHR_mesh_quantization); pass -noq for engine-import GLBs until Unreal/Godot import is qualified.

gltf-transform.notes: Installed with --ignore-scripts: native texture compression (sharp) is unavailable; validation, inspection and geometry operations work.

blender-asset-tracer.use: List and pack .blend dependencies (bat list / bat pack)
blender-asset-tracer.notes: BAT 2.x launches Blender; the wrapper pins BAT_BLENDER to /data/ai/toolchains/blender/5.2.3. Never use /usr/bin/blender (Fedora package with an incompatible OCIO config).

gdtoolkit.notes: gdformat rewrites files; run it only on version-controlled sources.

rejected.commercial export add-ons: closed source or paid; not installed
